item.title: WhatsApp Web finally gets voice and video calls, no app needed
item.description: WhatsApp has begun rolling out voice and video calling on WhatsApp Web. The feature lets users make calls directly from a browser with end to end encryption enabled by default. Group calls and more calling tools are expected in future updates.

item.title: Valentine’s Day affordable gift ideas under Rs 1000 to pamper your boyfriend or husband
item.description: Curated Valentine’s Day gift ideas for boyfriend and husband highlight playful and interest-led choices. Here are the top gift ideas that feel personal, thoughtful and memorable without leaning on clichés or excess.

item.title: Shocking! THIS muscle power-boosting supplement could silently kill you
item.description: Creatine is known to have an “osmotic effect,” meaning it draws water into muscle cells. In some people, this could lead to relative dehydration if fluid intake is not increased.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Election 2026: As DMK delays seat-sharing, TN Congress leaders head to Delhi to meet Rahul Gandhi
item.description: Congress leaders point out that while their own committee, led by Tamil Nadu in-charge Girish Chodankar, met Chief Minister M.K. Stalin back on December 3, the DMK has yet to constitute its own negotiation panel despite an announcement on February 3.

item.title: Pakistan want ICC to compensate Bangladesh for T20 World Cup ouster
item.description: Officials of ICC, Pakistan Cricket Board and Bangladesh Cricket Board met at Lahore’s Gaddafi Stadium on Sunday to find a way past the deadlock.

item.title: NEET UG 2026 registration for MBBS, BDS open till March 8; check new rules here
item.description: The NEET UG 2026 exam will be held on May 3. The registration process started on February 7 and will be open till March 8.

item.title: Explained: Japan’s snap-election results and what they mean for the region
item.description: Japan’s snap election results carry more significance than just a parliamentary reshuffle, preparing a more confident and regionally self-assertive Japan be it economically or in terms of strengthening its national security.

item.title: Mahayuti takes early lead in Maharashtra Zilla Parishad, Panchayat Samiti polls
item.description: According to the latest trends from the Zilla Parishad polls, the BJP is leading in seven councils, the Shiv Sena in two, and the NCP in two, indicating a clear edge for Mahayuti. The Congress is ahead in one Zilla Parishad seat so far.

item.title: Apple 2026 product roadmap: iPhone 17e, iPads, Macs, low cost MacBook plans
item.description: Apple is kicking off 2026 with the iPhone 17e, refreshed iPads, and new Macs. The strategy focuses on newer chips, steady pricing, and wider reach in emerging markets. Bigger changes, including foldables and touch Macs, are planned for later this year.

item.title: Upcoming Mutual Fund NFOs: Invest in Thematic Funds, FoFs, and ETFs
item.description: Seven new mutual fund NFOs are launching this week, offering diverse investment opportunities. These include three fund-of-funds (FoF), two thematic funds (ESG, Business Cycle), an index-based ETF (Hospitals), and a Silver ETF. Investors can explore options across various asset classes and themes, strengthening portfolios with new market offerings from leading fund houses, available for subscription now.
